items.q: We made those records in 1926, first orthophonic recordings, electrical recordings.

ctx.x: That's his uncle. We made those records in 1926, first orthophonic recordings, electrical recordings. Tommy -- later on, around about the early '30's, about the middle '30's, he joined Father Divine's church.
Oh, I wondered what happened to him.
